reason: A MATLAB MCP session bootstrap file was echoed into the episode transcript by an agent grep, leaking the live session apiKey (port/path/pid retained; only the credential value is replaced).
replacementRule: sha256(token) first 12 hex, so an authorized holder can still confirm which session this was without publishing it
claimLimit: Everything else in events.jsonl is byte-for-byte unchanged; the pristine copy existed only transiently and was never committed.
